description: Hotel Award Radar policy — Phase 1, Gondola MCP only. Config, never code. Observations are append-only and completely separate from cash stays; no valuation, no buy-points math, no ranking exists yet. The request plan (1 search + 2 calls per detail-checked hotel) is printed BEFORE execution and hard-capped.

gondola.note: Free anonymous MCP (no key, no account). A 403/429/503 or handshake refusal is BLOCKED: stop, record, never retry within the run.

budget.note: detailTopN hotels (cheapest by stated points total) additionally get get_multi_night_rates (full-stay confirmation) and get_booking_link. 1 + 2×detailTopN must fit maxCallsPerRun; the CLI refuses otherwise.

programMap.note: Source program name (lowercased) → our hotel program enum — the same key space as the buy-points promo feed and stay-property affiliations. An unmapped program keeps the source's own name normalized; nothing is guessed.
